data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Priyal symbolizes the ultimate goal and purpose of life, which is to attain the unwavering love and blessings of God. In Hindu philosophy, the divine is perceived as the all-loving, all-giving, and primordial being, and the ultimate goal is to unite the individual self with this infinite source of love. The name Priyal serves as a constant reminder of this goal and the path one must tread in order to attain it.
